controls.name: C-7d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-12T00:00:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-19T09:30:00.000Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
        AND event.outcome == "failure"
        AND process.name == "sshd"
| STATS hourly_count = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY hour = DATE_TRUNC(1 hour, @timestamp)
| SORT hour ASC
